# Human Proxy KR - LLM Index

Last-Updated: 2026-03-04
Language: ko-KR (primary), en (secondary)

## Canonical Summary
Human Proxy is a platform where AI delegates human-required tasks, reviews submissions, and settles payments only after approval.
